Dapsone is used for the suppression of skin le- sions in dermatitis herpetiformis (p.1578). The mechanism of ac- tion is unknown but is unrelated to its antimicrobial activity. Re- ports, generally involving small numbers of patients, suggest that dapsone may also be beneficial for bullous or mucous membrane pemphigoid (p.1582), pyoderma gangrenosum (p.1583), recur- rent erythema multiforme (p.1580), and urticaria (p.1584). Topi- cal dapsone is available in the USA for the treatment of acne. Spider bites.
